title: A killer's code cracked 51 years later

lines.text: A serial killer sent a coded letter in 1969. It took 51 years to crack.
The Zodiac Killer mailed it to the San Francisco Chronicle in November 1969.
It had 340 symbols, and nobody could read it.
For decades, codebreakers tried and failed.
Then in December 2020, three amateur codebreakers solved it.
David Oranchak, Sam Blake and Jarl Van Eycke used software that tested around 650,000 possible solutions.
The FBI confirmed it was correct.
But the message gave no new clues about who the killer was.
The code is solved. The Zodiac Killer is still unidentified.

sources.claim: 340 cipher mailed to the San Francisco Chronicle on 8 November 1969; solved 5 December 2020 by David Oranchak, Sam Blake and Jarl Van Eycke using AZdecrypt (~650,000 solutions tested); FBI verified; no clues to identity
